spec_basis: docs/roadmap.md §2 (G1-FEEDBACK outputs a mechanism profile, not PASS/FAIL)
docs/process-model-design.md §20.2a evolution 追加 (mandatory reconciliation with the 08-17 IC refutation)
preconditions: WRITTEN reconciliation, before any measurement: why per-site feedback slots + sidecar do not repeat the 08-17 IC refutation (fast arm already 2-3 cyc; bolt-on cache cannot pay its miss tax) given the 08-25 attribution (op_get_field re-pays hash probing every access, 47 insn, 23% cycles bucket-load stall). If the reconciliation cannot distinguish the new mechanism from the refuted one, the spike does not start.
shape identity guard uses the PERF-SHAPE-ID dual-domain contract shape (u64 identity, per-Runtime counter) — no raw-pointer guards on mutable shapes

arms.carrier: disposable per-site side table (thrown away after the spike; NOT the production sidecar container)
arms.poison_policy: sliding_window (consecutive-fail thresholds never trigger on alternating bimorphic sites — ledger §20.2a)

target_workloads.controls: remaining bench_v8 v9 suite (zlib skip contract)

primary_metric: paired per-benchmark fixed-work time ratio on the anchor set; anchor geomean as summary

minimum_effect.rule: an arm earns a non-disabled profile only if it shows >= +2% on >= 2 anchor benchmarks each with a per-benchmark confidence interval excluding 1.0, OR anchor geomean >= +1.5%
minimum_effect.basis: proposed (instrument resolution: suite-level ruler resolves ~0.7%; single-benchmark high-sample is the sanctioned high-resolution mode)

maximum_regression.site_metadata: report bytes/site for every arm; side-table RSS <= 1% of workload heap peak

correctness_gates: zig build test, zig build smoke
test262 subset covering property access/invalidations touched by the slots
invalidation soundness demo: mutation/relocation/ABA cases from the shape-identity contract must all invalidate
sample_protocol: measurement contract (sha256 020f2f18...); >=8 paired ABBA samples per benchmark, pinned big core, CV <= 5%; frequency adjudication before per-event cost claims (contract clause 9)

selected_feedback_profile.site_metadata_budget: <bytes/site, from the winning arm's measured footprint>

verdicts.pass: monomorphic (or collect_only) clears minimum_effect within regression limits -> G1-FEEDBACK selects that profile; PERF-P05 activates
verdicts.redesign: ONLY pic2 clears minimum_effect -> per roadmap §2, evolution Phase 0.5 spec must be revised before implementation; G1-FEEDBACK waits for the revision
verdicts.fail: no arm clears minimum_effect -> profile = disabled; the 08-17 refutation stands for interpreter-level feedback; feedback remains a Phase 2 JIT-input question only
